 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
21.4.2023 Order No.
03. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
2. Learned counsel for the State, on instruction, submits that notice has been served on the informant/victim on 15.04.2023.
There is no appearance on behalf of the informant/victim when the matter is called.

3. The petitioner is an accused in connection with Special G.R. Case No.98 of 2019, pending in the Court of the learned ADJ- cum-Special Judge under POCSO Act, Bolangir, arising out of Titilagarh P.S. Case No.243 of 2019 for commission of alleged offences under Sections 366/376(2)(n)/506/34 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C by the learned ADJ-cum-Special Judge under POCSO Act, Bolangir by order dated 17.12.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 13.07.2022 and as charge sheet has been filed on 04.08.2022, further continuance of the petitioner in custody is not warranted.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

8. Considering the tenor thereof and taking into account the filing of charge sheet and period of custody, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
